text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk through the park, I 
came across Fine Motion playing with some 
children, accompanied by Air Shakur 
standing watch beside them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Three, three... This one is... three 
leaves too!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, over here! Looks like there might 
be a four-leaf clover over in this spot!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, really? Let's see, let's look for it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What is it, Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Break time's already over. I'm still in 
the middle of logging pacing data here. 
Get your butt back to training already.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry Shakur, just a little longer, 
please! We couldn't find one last time, so 
today I really want to find a four-leaf 
clover with these kids.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Big sis! Hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm coming! Wait for me~.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Wait... Damn it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, this is incredible. It's surprisingly 
hard to find even one!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Why's Her Royal Highness getting so 
carried away that she's kneeling in the 
dirt?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Besides, why waste energy on this crap? 
Back where you're from, ain't "three-leaf" 
clovers supposed to be the important ones 
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, that may be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe it's because I came to this 
country?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hah?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Searching together for what the people of 
this country cherish, and rejoicing 
together when we finally find it—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
See, since I've come all the way to Japan, 
I want to make every moment, including the 
time spent searching, a precious treasure 
of mine.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Search where there's more foot traffic. 
Clovers getting stepped on and damaged 
during the bud stage have a higher 
statistical probability of mutating into 
four leaves.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Shut it. Let's get this over with.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Found it! Awesome, awesome! Big sisters, 
it was really there!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, prickly big sis! You know 
everything!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch, don't cling onto me...!
(Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey! What the hell are you taking 
pictures of!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This is another precious memory of mine, 
you know♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, screw this...! That's it, we're 
heading back!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait up~. It turned out so well, too. 
I'll send it to you later~!
